_comment: Editor layout for the photokinetic FCS model (FCSKineticsModel). Drive an arbitrary N-state photochemical rate scheme (dark/excitation matrices, state brightnesses) whose power-dependent saturation shape is integrated numerically. Fast mode keeps the Gaussian volume and only the photokinetic bunching.

sections.label: Mode
sections.description: Full: numerical volume integration, the amplitude carries the saturation volume expansion V0/Veff. Fast: Gaussian volume with the photokinetic bunching factor only — no volume expansion, so do not read N from a high-power fit made in this mode.

sections.label: Dye
sections.description: Read the molar extinction coefficient at the excitation wavelength from the MMFDB dye repository. Leave empty to type epsilon in yourself.

sections.label: States
sections.description: Number of states in the photochemical scheme. Two is the minimum (ground + excited); add a state for every dark, isomeric or transferred state the dye has.
What the model is computing right now: the peak excitation rate the scheme is being driven at, or a note that P = 0 leaves you with the analytical Gaussian.
